records.title: The rational Hodge conjecture for CM abelian varieties
records.scope: All dimensions and codimensions on complex CM abelian varieties. Original-X source coverage outside this class is not provided.
records.application: conditional source theorem; no theorem is imported as an axiom
records.review: Source authentication and selected theorem/proof extraction; not an independent audit of the entire upstream proof

records.title: Smooth isometric immersions of closed surfaces into Euclidean four-space
records.scope: Closed smooth real Riemannian surfaces; immersion into R4, no orientability assumption.

records.review: Source authentication and selected theorem/proof extraction; not an independent audit of the entire upstream proof

records.title: Projection moments, positive cap domination, and Riesz estimates on the sphere
records.scope: Real orthogonal projections, random frame densities and affine-height factors.

records.title: Petty's projection-volume conjecture in dimensions at least four
records.scope: Convex bodies in real dimension at least four; sharp normalized projection-volume lower bound with ellipsoid equality.
records.application: scope comparison only; no projection-body estimate is used as a Chow existence theorem
records.review: Source authentication and selected theorem/proof extraction; not an independent audit of the entire upstream proof

records.title: A Smooth Metric with No Local Isometric Immersion into Three-Space
records.scope: Smooth positive-definite real surface metric with no smooth immersion near the distinguished point; local smooth realization is not determined by the full Taylor jet.
records.application: scope comparison only; no general smooth projector or algebraic realization follows
records.review: Source authentication and selected theorem/proof extraction; not an independent audit of the entire upstream proof
